Build confirms `/` now renders as `◐ (Partial Prerender)` — the static shell generates at build time (the `api.example.com` fetch is postponed, not run until request time). Changes:

- **app/page.tsx** — removed the top-level `await` that blocked the whole route; each section is now an async component behind its own `<Suspense>` boundary, so the shell streams instantly and data streams in. `React.cache` dedupes the shared fetch across the three sections into one request per visit.
- **app/CardStats.tsx, RevenueChart.tsx, LatestInvoices.tsx** — added layout-matched skeleton fallbacks; these ship inside the prerendered shell (headings included) with no layout shift.
- **app/loading.tsx** — replaced the full-page spinner with the composed skeleton, keeping client navigations layout-stable.
